thread:
inc-bot: Pager — SEV2 — elevated 429s/5xx for org `delta-778` (Delta Labs). Error rate spiked at 02:05 UTC, rolling 1m 429 rate = 18%; 5xx rate = 4%. @oncall-elena paging you now.
oncall-elena: I see it on graphs — latency also up (~350ms p95 to 820ms). What’s the impact on customer-facing requests?
sam-sre: Backfill from logs: most 429s are coming from a burst of long-context generation pipelines. QPS jumped from 8 -> 60 for that org in 2m.
alex-platform: Confirmed. They have a background batch that mis-scheduled and started sending interactive requests. We need to throttle or create a temporary org-level override.
maria-cs: Delta Labs reporting timeouts in their app, CSM is on the phone. They want an ETA to restore normal behavior.
chris-eng: Can we ask them to pause non-critical jobs? If not, we can do a short temporary rate bump to avoid 5xx cascade while we apply a policy.
ops-runbook: Runbook snippet for org hotfix (internal):
```
# temp override: increase qps for org
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.example/api/v1/orgs/delta-778/overrides" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"qps":25, "burst":60, "expires_at":"2026-03-17T02:35:00Z", "reason":"Emergency delta spike"}'
```
oncall-elena: I’m on it. Will do a short bump (10 -> 25 qps) for 30m while we contact the customer and throttle the misbehaving pipeline. Applying now.
inc-bot: action_note: oncall-elena executed override request at 02:08:12 UTC (audit id: ov-20260317-02-08-el).
oncall-elena: override applied. Confirming metrics — 429s dropping to 3% in the last 45s, latency p95 down to ~420ms.
sam-sre: Can we also enable prefix cache for that org’s common prompts? Might reduce tokens. I’ll push a lightweight cache config on the gateway.
achris-eng: Pushing cache flag now — sending toggles via edge featureflag service.
maria-cs: CSM on the call says they can pause the background job in 10 minutes; they asked us to keep the override until then and then revert.
oncall-elena: Noted. I’ll set expiry to 02:35 UTC and will revert earlier if they confirm pause.
ops-runbook: Reminder: file an incident summary with root cause (mis-scheduled long-run job), actions (temp qps bump, cache toggle, customer pause), and postmortem owner.
oncall-elena: Handing off to @sam-sre for postmortem, I’m going offline after handoff.
sam-sre: Ack — taking PM. Will collect logs, request Delta Labs request IDs, and confirm billing impact.
maria-cs: Delta CSM will escalate on behalf of customer if any billing anomalies; they requested a note we’re not charging for emergency override.
achris-eng: Quick note: config applied was non-persistent; manual revert required. I added a TODO to the override entry.
oncall-elena: Closing pager. If anything re-escalates, page the SEV2 channel. :thumbsup:
